2122623891294052757.en_summary: Amazon to invest $7B in renewable energy in India by 2030. $AMZN announced 4 new wind & solar projects in the country, including what it says is its largest wind farm contracted in Asia so far. Aims to cut the carbon emissions from every unit of electricity it uses by 65% by 2030.
2122623891294052757.zh_summary: 亞馬遜計劃到2030年在印度投資70億美元可再生能源。$AMZN 宣布4個新的風能和太陽能項目，包括其在亞洲迄今簽約的最大風電場。目標到2030年將每單位用電的碳排放減少65%。

2122621372635771363.en_summary: The U.S. Commerce and Justice Departments have released a detailed timeline of their Megaspeed investigation, confirming $NVDA stopped selling to the Singapore data-center company in June 2025, when it was placed on Nvidia's internal "no sell" list. Timeline includes 2024 investigation opening after suspicious activity, May 2025 records request, June 2025 no-sell list and on-site inspection with then-CEO Alice Huang, then Justice Department leading criminal investigation. Disclosure after Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent criticized Commerce for not blacklisting. Nvidia's internal list is separate from the Entity List.
2122621372635771363.zh_summary: 美國商務部和司法部發布了其Megaspeed調查的詳細時間表，確認 $NVDA 在2025年6月停止向新加坡數據中心公司出售，當時該公司被列入Nvidia內部「不出售」名單。時間表包括2024年因可疑活動開啟調查、2025年5月要求記錄、2025年6月列入不出售名單並進行現場檢查採訪當時CEO Alice Huang，之後司法部主導刑事調查。財政部長Scott Bessent批評商務部未將其列入黑名單後披露。Nvidia內部名單與實體清單分開。

2122619064103104876.en_summary: $TSM just posted its best month ever. October revenue: ~$17.9bn, up 59.7% from a year earlier, up 14.7% from September, 14% above the previous record set in August. January–October revenue up 43.3%. TSMC guided Q4 to $52.3–54.3bn; October alone delivered about 34% of the midpoint. To hit midpoint Nov/Dec need ~$17.7bn a month, top of range ~$18.2bn; analysts expected ~$16.4–17.4bn a month. October already beat the top of analyst range. If next two months match October, Q4 lands near top of guidance. Drivers are AI demand and 2nm shipments. TSMC raised its 2026 growth forecast to ~44% in October, looks safe.
2122619064103104876.zh_summary: $TSM 剛剛公布其有史以來最佳月份。10月收入約179億美元，同比增長59.7%，較8月增長14.7%，比8月的前記錄高14%。1月至10月收入增長43.3%。TSMC第四季指引523-543億美元；10月單獨約佔中點的34%。要達到中點，11月和12月每月需約177億美元，範圍頂端約182億美元；分析師預期每月164-174億美元。10月已超過分析師範圍頂端。如果後兩個月匹配10月，第四季接近指引頂端。驅動因素為AI需求和2nm出貨。TSMC在10月將2026年增長預測上調至約44%，看起來安全。
